item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Sep 16
item.description:

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Sep 15
item.description:
96 development commits

Food & Drink

  • Creamy and milky tea variants adjust healing effectiveness and duration (e.g., creamy healing tea 97 HP/20 s, milky healing tea 112 HP/45 s).
  • Milk can be processed after 4 hours in a refrigerated container to produce skimmed milk (½ calories, 80 % hydration, ½ health) and cream (½ calories, 20 % hydration, +50 % health).

World & Structures

  • Apples now have a 10 % chance to survive if the tree is harvested before fruit is picked, and fruit no longer falls when a tree is hit.
  • Apartment complexes are flagged as safe zones and placement restrictions near them now correctly warn when too close.

Animals & AI

  • Critters remain active throughout the night, and rabbits no longer react to nearby items, reducing server load.
  • Turtle spawning issues have been resolved, ensuring turtles appear in the world as intended.
  • Sheep now correctly mark attackers as hostile, walk, attack players, and die as expected.

UI & Controls

  • UI improvements: background tile sprite restored, server browser filter works correctly, player count display remains stable when switching gamemodes, and market terminals show a "No Power" message when unpowered.
  • Alt + Mouse wheel now provides fine‑grained zoom control.
  • Store UI now falls back to the first completed image request if the HTTP image delay expires, reducing missing images.
  • Added a new bind command for gamepad defaults and fixed reset behavior when no keyboard/mouse is bound.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Added explosive setup to certain weapons, enabling explosive damage.
  • Fixed beef spoil item assignment, ensuring proper food spoilage.

Building & Placement

  • Fences no longer sink into terrain, can be placed on slopes and angled up to 20°, improving building precision.
  • Ladder hatches are now skinnable and feature open/close functionality for workshop use.

Equipment & Protection

  • Hazmat suits now include the missing component, restoring intended protection levels.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Sep 14
item.description:
80 development commits

Server & UI

  • Fixed inaccurate server browser gamemode filter counts and prevented mixing of unrelated gamemodes.
  • Fixed various input binding issues, including gamepad key‑assign closure, key latching after input clear, and missing map close binding.

Animals, Resources & Mounting

  • Restored missing beef resource links for livestock.
  • Lamb and calf corpses no longer yield any resources when killed.
  • Attacking farm animals now marks you as hostile to safezones.
  • Adjusted critter population settings.
  • Fixed issues with multiple animals near vehicles and added support for mounting Gen2 AI via a new NPCMountable component.

Structures & Collision

  • Halved fence gate opening/closing speed for smoother operation.
  • Fixed fence collider issues, enabled fence demolition, and added blue highlight to demolishable fences.
  • Fixed hitbox collision detection errors.

Combat, Weapons & Cooking

  • Adjusted salvaged cleaver distance to correct melee reach.
  • Fixed raw beef missing its cooking reference and added new meat types to all oven prefabs.

UI & Visuals

  • Store images now correctly generate and display blurhash placeholders, preventing missing or broken backgrounds in the store UI.
  • Editor now reads textures as sRGB when possible, improving color accuracy of generated blurhash previews.
